text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri presides over opening of a three-day scientific meeting on "the place of Morocco in the world".
- Former Israeli Prime Minister Shimon Peres tells Le Matin du Sahara: "I hope King Hassan will continue to back the peace process in the Middle East".
- Opposition parties hail clean-up of electoral lists as crucial step to democratic change.
- Appeal of pharmacist jailed for selling contaminated blood products postponed to Jan 28.

- Crown Prince Mohamed says at the opening of American-Moroccan trade and investment office in New York "we must build a partnership able to make the best of our common political points and boost economic cooperation".
- Home saving plan under discussion but still doubts about accompanying measures to avoid over-taxation.
- Euro-Mediterranean meeting of businessmen in Marrakesh made clear that the European Union would not be "Santa Claus".
